headline: The candidate buffer has FOUR distinct references, not one, and they form two complete report paths plus a copy in and a copy out. The 28-byte variant sends the candidate struct DIRECTLY, and a third site fills the whole candidate (including +0x0c/+0x0d) from an external source r13 - which is a positive hit for option A of the brief.

evidence: 1e0e29c: r0 = sp+1080 ; call 0x1e07464 (serialize the candidate IN PLACE)
0x1e0e29c_0x1e0e2c2.conclusion: payload length is 0x0e or 0x1c depending on state+0x35, and r2 points at the CANDIDATE ITSELF (sp+1080), not at a copy. So the 28-byte variant transmits the raw candidate struct, including +0x0c/+0x0d and the six extra s16 fields.

evidence: 1e0e3b2: b[sp+1092] = sextra(r13, 8, 1)   <-- LT seed = packed bit 8
1e0e3bc: b[sp+1093] = sextra(r13, 9, 1)   <-- RT seed = packed bit 9
1e0e3c6/1e0e3cc: r1 = sp+1080 ; r0 = r2 ; call 0x1e0a5f2 (injector A)
1e0e3d6/1e0e3dc: r1 = sp+1080 ; r0 = r2 ; call 0x1e0a656 (injector B)
0x1e0e3c6_0x1e0e3d6.conclusion: an exact structural duplicate of the sequence at 0x1e0da54..0x1e0da82, feeding the 28-byte path instead of the 14-byte path.

evidence: 1e0db8c: r0 = sp+996 ; 1e0db90: r1 = sp+1080 ; r2 = 0x1c ; call 0x2f922a
0x1e0db90.conclusion: the candidate is copied to another stack buffer (sp+996), i.e. consumed by a further report/USB builder.

0x1e0cd24_0x1e0cd2e.role: a THIRD population path - the candidate filled from an external source
0x1e0cd24_0x1e0cd2e.conclusion: 28 bytes are copied FROM r13 INTO the candidate. This is the first proven way for analogue LT/RT bytes to reach +0x0c/+0x0d - it is option A of the brief, and it means the packed-bit seeding is best read as a DEFAULT/FALLBACK rather than the only source.

write_timeline.method: scanned the container 0x1e0ac14-0x1e0f154 for stores into the candidate
write_timeline.result: no hex-form stores found; the candidate is written only through pointer or through the decimal stack forms b[sp+1092]/b[sp+1093] used by the packed-bit seeding
write_timeline.tool_caveat: IMPORTANT: this disassembly renders stack offsets in DECIMAL (b[sp+1092]) while global offsets are hex. A hex-only store scan silently misses every stack-based candidate write. Recorded so this trap is not repeated.
timeline: 1. packed-bit seeding: b[sp+1092] = bit 8 (LT), b[sp+1093] = bit 9 (RT) - sites 0x1e0da58/0x1e0da62 and 0x1e0e3b2/0x1e0e3bc
2. injector A (0x1e0a5f2) overwrites candidate +0x04/+0x06 with canned constants when the low nibble of r2 is 1..10
3. injector B (0x1e0a656) overwrites candidate +0x08/+0x0a on the high nibble
4. at 0x1e0cd2e the WHOLE candidate is filled from r13 (28 bytes) - this can overwrite the seeds with analogue values
5. the candidate is serialized in place (0x1e07464) and either copied to sp+1052 for the 14-byte frame or sent directly for the 28-byte frame
6. at 0x1e0dad2 the 14-byte form is compared against the last-sent mirror and only then copied to 0x4ecc

lt_rt_verdict.14B_path: carries whatever the candidate holds at +0x0c/+0x0d at send time: bit-derived if only the seeding ran, analogue if the r13 copy at 0x1e0cd2e ran
lt_rt_verdict.28B_path: carries the raw candidate, so it necessarily exposes the same two bytes plus the six extra s16 fields
lt_rt_verdict.status: option A SUPPORTED (a second population path can place analogue values there); option B REFUTED (both variants use the same candidate and the same serializer, so the field ORDER does not differ); option C not settled; option D possible but not shown - the synthetic injectors sit inside these same paths, which does place diagnostic capability here
lt_rt_verdict.grade: the existence of the r13 population path is PROVEN STATIC; whether it is the source of the live analogue values is NOT proven

usb_trio.status: HEAD ONLY - mandatory phase, still not fully reversed

not_advanced: raw live D2 corpus re-read (byte 15/16 distributions)
